name: rekanbot-open
description: RekanBot Open: agen AI coding desktop open source, ringan dan bebas provider.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/cli && tsc -p apps/desktop/electron && tsc -p apps/desktop/renderer
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rekanbot/core && npm run build -w @rekanbot/cli && npm run build -w @rekanbot/desktop
scripts.test: npm run build -w @rekanbot/core && node --test packages/core/test/ packages/cli/test/
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run typecheck && npm test
